remarks: Charming and urban-chic studio in the historic Clocktower building! Built in 1903, this unique home features high ceilings, exposed brick, and large windows that fill the space with light. The separate kitchen comes equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and plenty of storage. Enjoy top-notch amenities, including a fitness center with sauna, a common room with billiards, an enclosed dog run, and a conference room with a full kitchen. Solar panels help keep energy costs low. Perfectly located near I-95, Merritt Parkway, The SONO Collection, Metro-North stations, and plenty of great dining options!
